Blob2ByteArray decodes into a new[] buffer of (6 * strlen) / 8 + 1 bytes and returns the length. Size and loop use strlen: LC_API_STRLEN_0 (0x30de54) is return strlen(a1), XP_API_STRLEN is strlen. Each blob byte is loaded signed (LDRSB, 0x82b0d8) and its key comes from the non-LC helper as signed char, sign-extended after the call (SXTB). A byte of 0x80 or more is negative, so its key is negative (0x84 gives -120). The shifts use the signed key: left shift on the unsigned bit pattern, right shift arithmetic as ASR. Shares decodeBlob with 89cd60. Tests: r1-tinyxml-and-c-libs-pack0-28604f-0_test.cpp (blob a, 0x84, 0x84, b, c, d decodes to 00 e2 fc c2), ssencdec_test.cpp
